label: Standard UPS
description: Standard shipping with tracking. Delivery dates depend on destination and carrier confirmation.

label: Express UPS
description: Expedited carrier service when available. Final delivery dates follow dispatch confirmation.

label: UPS Next Day
description: Next-business-day service within eligible US destinations; cutoffs and availability depend on carrier.

label: Priority Processing
description: Priority order handling and preparation ahead of standard orders, subject to daily capacity.

label: Cold Chain Shipping
description: Insulated packaging with cooling materials for products eligible for cold-chain handling. No guaranteed transit temperature.

label: Shipping Protection
description: Optional seller-backed protection for eligible packages lost or damaged in transit. Read coverage terms before selecting.
